item.title: Laying the Groundwork
item.description: Welcome to my standups - a series where I share what I’m working on, thoughts rummaging around in my head, and what I’m excited for! 🚀 What I’m working on # Last week, I was writing up scripts that would let GitHub Enterprise Site Admins audit entire orgs within their enterprise servers.
